title: Independent performance campaigns collided in stable-plan artifact custody

source_observation.environment: Independent fresh 3.2.5 confirmation from dev commit 32fba8fd8247ecf9660ebdcdb7f96aa8d6003de2, immutable 3.2.5 and 3.2.3 archives, Factorio 2.1.13, and the exact 2.1 mod closure.
source_observation.fact: All governed confirmation performance lanes passed, but relocation failed because the stable input-plan custody destination build/results/performance-custody/FFDC28515AB21434 already contained the distinct raw artifact tree from the preceding convergence campaign.

reproducer.command: .\tools\mir.ps1 verify run --target 2.1 --profile full --candidate dist\more-infinite-research_3.2.5.zip --prior dist\more-infinite-research_3.2.3.zip --factorio <exact-2.1.13> --mods C:\Projects\Factorio\testmods\2.1 --no-reuse --plan build\results\terminal-calibration\3.2.5-confirmation-32fba8fd-plan.json
reproducer.expected: The stable input fingerprint owns a custody namespace. Each independently measured immutable raw artifact tree receives its own full tree-SHA child; an exact repeat verifies and adopts the existing child.
reproducer.observed: The first convergence tree occupied the stable-plan destination. A later distinct confirmation tree was rejected after successful evidence production because relocation treated the namespace itself as a single-use artifact directory.
